title: Rewrite the percent as a decimal or a fraction
text: $$25\%$$ means 25 per 100, which simplifies to $$\frac{1}{4}$$. 'Of' means multiply. A common mistake is to add 25 to 80, or to multiply by 25 instead of by $$\frac{1}{4}$$. What is the denominator of $$25\%$$ written as a fraction in lowest terms?

title: Take one fourth of 80
text: Dividing by 4 is the same as multiplying by $$\frac{1}{4}$$. What is $$80 \div 4$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$25\%$$ of $$80 = 0.25 \times 80 = 20$$. Common mistake: answering $$25$$, or $$105$$ from adding. General rule: to find $$p\%$$ of a number, convert $$p\%$$ to $$\frac{p}{100}$$ or to a decimal, then multiply.
